positions.title: Quality Analyst
positions.description:
Experience with Account Opening, Digital Banking, Mobile Banker, Kiosk applications.  

 Hancock Whitney Bank :  worked on digital banking and Account opening applications. Had responsibilities to create/manage test cases and regression/smoke test of all applications. tested all application on all devices. worked on ACH, Transfer Money, Enrollment and other related services.  Also Tested Roll Up Matrix for an Account opening applications. 

2. Test Account opening, Rollup matrix, mobile banker (App Management) applications and create test cases for applications and maintain test cases for Bank of North Carolina, Iberia Bank, Virtual Bank, Citizens Bank. 

3. Had responsibilities to test kiosk applications for Union bank. Tested  and created test cases for kiosk applications - cash back, transfer, deposit features. 

Responsibilities:

•       Analyze the defects and assign the priority for fix
•	Work closely with the offshore team in providing functional support for project implementation
•	Create test plan and test strategy for various releases of product and identifying test scenarios 
•	Gather business requirements, prepare/ analyze business requirement documents, prepare test scenarios, and create test scripts
•	Improve the processes and identify gaps to increase the productivity of the team
•	Execute System, Integration, Regression testing and defect management
•	Reporting of test execution status and defect reports to respective stakeholders
•	Interact with the clients for daily status and work allocation, issues, and follow up
•	Create and maintain automation tests for various flows involving multiple systems

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Environment: Jquery-Mobile(1.4.5), HTML5, CCS3, Javascript, PhoneGap, AJAX, JSON
Responsibilities:
- ApproveIT is an app and web based application available for small and medium businesses over    
  the cloud. 
- Developed Web Services using Java scripts.
- Developed and updated mobile applications using different modules in Jquery-Mobile and 
  Javascript.
- Experience in reviewing and updating requirements.
- Modified logic behind some of the screens in JQuery mobile screens.
- Upgraded the JQuery Mobile version.
- Developed Test cases and Tested the app manually using Unit Testing and Ad-hoc Testing, to make sure the normal functionality is not lost.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Project: Resilient Airborne Network
Environment: Shell scripting,Ubuntu,Objective C,MS office
Responsibilities:
•	Assisted in designing network topologies using Raspberry Pi's.
•	Testing Communication between ground units and the Quadcopter using Raspberry pi's.
•	Worked on Shell Scripting, TCP/IP layers especially Transport and Network layer.
•	Understanding concepts of wireless technologies.

positions.title: Project Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed and designed Customer Relationship Management(CRM) system for Insurance company which provides service to their customers.
•	Designed web based application "Online Auto Insurance System" using ASP.NET , HTML , CSS and MYSQL Server.
•	Notify payment reminder to the customers through an email .
•	Used Agile software methodologies to develop application.

projects.title: Database System
projects.description: Write a JAVA program that can join two sqlite databases containing similar tables.

projects.title: Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm:
projects.description: Java program to implement ECDSA BigIntegers for numbers and 	using Hash functions library provided by the java API for encryption of the 	message. Basically user provides an equation of a curve, the program checks 	if the curve is valid and hence generates a point of infinity of the curve 	which is used with other public and private keys to sign and verify any file.
